summary: Correctly extends HEAD-request fallback to retry with GET on TooManyRedirects, fixing infinite-redirect-loop URLs that regressed after HEAD was enforced in #7936. Change is minimal and correct; only nit is a redundant second edit.

issues.description: Second edit `except (Exception, requests.exceptions.TooManyRedirects)` is redundant: TooManyRedirects subclasses RequestException < Exception, so it is already caught by `Exception`. Harmless but adds noise; only the first except clause change is functionally needed.
First clause uses bare `HTTPError` (imported name) but new exception uses fully-qualified `requests.exceptions.TooManyRedirects`, mildly inconsistent import style.
